title: SSE / WebSocket Channel Plan
description: A structured plan for a real-time browser-server channel, so the transport decision and this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/sse_ws_channel_audit.mjs.

direction.description: The dominant traffic direction, per the decision diagram in SKILL.md.

chosenTransport.description: The transport this plan commits to.

behindBufferingProxy.description: True if the channel traverses nginx or another response-buffering proxy/LB/CDN in production.

proxyBufferingDisabled.description: True if X-Accel-Buffering: no is set on SSE responses AND the proxy is configured with proxy_buffering off.

httpVersion.description: The HTTP version negotiated for the SSE origin (irrelevant post-upgrade for WebSocket).

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: Idle-connection heartbeat cadence: SSE comment line or WebSocket ping frame. Should be <=30.

reconnectBackoffJittered.description: True if WebSocket reconnect logic uses full-jitter exponential backoff (SSE reconnects automatically).

replayOnReconnect.description: True if the channel promises to replay events missed while disconnected.

serverReplayBufferKeyedById.description: For SSE with replay: true if the server persists events keyed by the emitted id: so Last-Event-ID resume actually works.

sequenceNumbersPersisted.description: For WebSocket with replay: true if the client persists the last-seen sequence number and the server resumes from it.

backpressureHandled.description: True if the server measures per-connection send-buffer growth and drops/batches/closes when a client falls behind.
